reviewer.agent: Claude Code (file handoff; environment names the handoff channel)

themes.label: Transnational tech domination and algorithmic control
themes.definition: Critique that a few (mostly US) transnational companies control platforms, content and algorithms, producing cultural domination and manipulation of behaviour.
themes.inclusion: Passages on dictatorship of the algorithm, few transnationals imposing systems and controlling content.
themes.exclusion: Inclusive governance calls without a domination critique (use AI_GLOBAL_GOVERNANCE).
themes.boundary_cases: Anti-capitalist critiques of AI misuse can take this code if concentration of power is explicit.

examples.quote: A few transnationals, almost all of them from the US, impose their operating systems and control the content that is seen, read and heard
We are suffering from the dictatorship of the algorithm.

themes.label: Inclusive UN-based AI governance for all
themes.definition: Calls for common norms and more inclusive global governance of AI, including voice for developing regions like Africa in AI governance decisions.
themes.inclusion: Passages calling for UN common norms on AI, inclusive governance of disruptive technologies, or African voice in global AI governance.
themes.exclusion: Critiques of corporate concentration without a governance call.
themes.boundary_cases: Demands that Africa be heard in global AI governance take this and AI_DIGITAL_DIVIDE if inequality is also raised.

examples.quote: establish at the UN as soon as possible common norms in order to unlock the transformative potential of new technologies, especially artificial intelligence
promote governance that is more inclusive in the use of the new ICTs and telecommunications, particularly the disruptive technologies such as artificial intelligence
climate issues and global governance of artificial intelligence

themes.label: AI misuse under capitalism threatening humanity
themes.definition: AI misuse, driven by capitalism, portrayed as a systemic threat that could worsen climate change and render most people unnecessary.
themes.inclusion: Passages linking AI misuse to capitalism, planetary destruction or mass human redundancy.
themes.exclusion: Technical loss-of-control safety concerns (use AI_SAFETY_EXISTENTIAL) or narrow job loss (use AI_ECONOMY_LABOR).
themes.boundary_cases: If the passage focuses on job displacement without systemic critique, use AI_ECONOMY_LABOR instead.

examples.quote: the unstoppable force of capitalism with the misuse of artificial intelligence would increase the climate change, would liquidate the planet

value.rationale: Passages come from Global South speeches embedding AI in critiques of unequal world order: Cuba targets US tech domination and calls for inclusive UN norms, Angola demands African voice in AI governance, and Bolivia frames AI misuse under capitalism as a civilizational threat.
